lines.differs: Better for AtliQ than Trustline NBFC: payment is due within 30 days of invoice receipt rather than 45 days.
Same as PayTrack Technologies: payment is due within 30 days of invoice receipt.
Same as Rohan Iyer: payment is due within 30 days of invoice receipt.
Same as Crestline Retail Inc: confidentiality obligations survive for three years after termination and indefinitely for trade secrets.
Better for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: AtliQ is not explicitly required to promptly notify the client upon discovering unauthorized disclosures.
Better for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: it contains no specific restrictions on downloading client data to personal devices or client-specific security rules.
Better for AtliQ than Crestline Retail Inc: the client's license to AtliQ's pre-existing tools is explicitly restricted to internal business purposes.
Better for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: the client's license to AtliQ's pre-existing tools is explicitly restricted to internal business purposes.
Better for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: the client's license to AtliQ's pre-existing tools is explicitly restricted to internal business purposes.
Worse for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: liability cap contains exceptions for confidentiality, indemnification, gross negligence, and willful misconduct, whereas Sunrise Foods had no exceptions.
Worse for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: liability cap includes additional exceptions for indemnification obligations, gross negligence, and willful misconduct beyond confidentiality and fraud.
Better for AtliQ than Crestline Retail Inc: indirect and consequential damages are excluded without exceptions, whereas Crestline carved out confidentiality and indemnification.
Worse for AtliQ than Acme Retail Group: IP indemnity is one-way against AtliQ instead of mutual, and mutual indemnity is restricted to bodily injury and property damage.
Better for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: AtliQ's indemnification liability is narrower, covering IP claims and mutual bodily injury or property damage claims only.
Better for AtliQ than Crestline Retail Inc: AtliQ is not required to indemnify for personnel employment claims, and negligence indemnity is limited to bodily injury and property damage.
Better for AtliQ than Acme Retail Group: delay exclusions are broader, explicitly including delays caused by client's third-party vendors and force majeure events.
Better for AtliQ than Brightwater Insurance Inc: liquidated damages are 0.5% of the milestone fee per week capped at 5%, instead of 1% of contract value per day uncapped.
Better for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: delay penalty rate is 0.5% per week instead of 1%, capped at 5%, with explicit delay exclusions.
Better for AtliQ than Crestline Retail Inc: there is no restriction prohibiting offshore or outside-US access to client data.
Better for AtliQ than Brightwater Insurance Inc: incident notification timeline is 72 hours instead of 24 hours, and offshore data processing is allowed.
Better for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: notification timeline is 72 hours instead of 24 hours, without regulator reporting obligations or mandatory audit rights.
Worse for AtliQ than CloudSpan Technologies: governing law is Illinois instead of Singapore, though arbitration remains under SIAC rules in Singapore.
Better for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: disputes are resolved by confidential SIAC arbitration in Singapore rather than litigation in DIFC courts.
Better for AtliQ than Northwind Logistics: arbitration is held under SIAC rules in Singapore rather than LCIA rules in London.
